punchline: Dan Harris wanted to call his book 'The Voice in My Head Is an Asshole'; the publisher said no.
thirty_sec: Dan Harris thinks everyone has a narrator in their head that comments on everything, usually unkindly. Reading Eckhart Tolle, he recognised himself, but 'observe your thoughts' came with no instructions. Meditation gave him the how: a small gap between the urge and the action, and a tool called RAIN, recognise, allow, investigate, don't identify. The voice never went quiet. It just stopped running the show.
